prods.title: Mornington Polo Blue/White Stripe
prods.body: Traditional spirit. Modern edge. The Mornington is where classic golf heritage meets contemporary design. With extended sleeves and a wider, boxier cut, it nods to the golden era of golf style while delivering a bold, updated silhouette built for today's game. Crafted from an ultra-premium polyester with 2-way stretch, the fabric offers a soft yet structured feel that keeps you comfortable from the first tee to the final putt. Contrast collar and sleeves, a traditional button placket, and chainstitch embroidery make it a staple wardrobe piece.

prods.title: Heritage Plaid Cap Red
prods.body: The Heritage Plaid Cap has a story. We found an old St Andrews cap in a thrift shop in Vietnam - it quickly became a favourite, and we couldn't stop thinking about why shapes like this don't exist anymore. Well, wonder no more. We brought it back - same soul, built for today. The unique 7-panel design and heritage plaid fabric give it a character you won't find anywhere else, while the canvas-backed front moulds to your head over time for a fit that becomes yours.

prods.title: Portsea Jacket
prods.body: The Portsea Jacket was built for golfers who refuse to compromise. Designed functionality-first with a sharp, modern aesthetic, it moves with you from the first tee to the 18th green - whatever the weather throws at you. Crafted from a premium 90/10 Nylon Spandex blend, the Portsea delivers four-way stretch and wind resistance without the bulk. The fully lined mesh interior keeps airflow moving so you stay comfortable under pressure.

prods.title: Sørensen Fairway Cover - Dark Nubuck
prods.body: A rough-out, reverse construction of the classic MacKenzie fairway cover, the  Sørensen Cover is built to get better over time. A simple yet detail heavy stash option, this limited opening run is built with Sørensen leather shell, Maharam vinyl base, and finished with a pile fleece lining. It comfortably fits all standard fairway metals (and woods) and features an inner woven-elastic band for added security. Sørensen Leather is an eco-conscious, global manufacturer of possibly the most sought-after and sustainable leather in the world. Established by Arne Sørensen in 1973, who built the business based in Denmark due to his earned access to local quality leather sourcing relationships. 50 years later, they remain a family owned business driven by the second generation of Sørensens at the strategic helm. Specs: -Measures 9.5”h x 3.75”w -Sørensen Royal Nubuck Shell -Pile Fleece Lining

prods.title: Soof Flash x Found Golf | Good Sport Bad Sport — Box Sweater
prods.body: 2026 Edition of 10 Cotton Made to order | Allow 2 weeks Soof Flash, founded by Safa El Samad, riffs on the language of flash tattoos, offering garments renewed through embroidered interventions. Collaborating with Ellen Keillar and Lance Peach of Found Golf, the team produced a series of custom garments combining Soof’s Good Sport Bad Sport 2025 flash collection with golf-specific motifs. Through humour, text and imagery, the works explore sport and golf as spaces of play, identity and performance. Price includes shipping.

prods.title: Briony Wright – Crushes Flowers | Cone Piece Vase
prods.body: 2026 Edition of 8 Hand poured cast aluminium 13.0 x 13.0 x 18.0cm Briony is a writer, editor and creative producer. In 2024, she cut the ribbon on her conceptual flower studio, Crushes Flowers, and now makes work across different mediums. Briony’s two-part installation combines floristry with spatial design as she draws reference from sports fields. The sand cast aluminium cone vases are replicase of the ubiquitous cone that we all ran, hopped, skipped and jumped over through childhood sport lessons. Accompanying the installation is a custom designed scent evocative of freshly cut grass. Price excludes shipping. This will be coordinated directly with the artist.

prods.title: Second Round Remake 03 Headcover | Limited Edition
prods.body: Cut from a vintage Mizuno golf jacket in black technical cloth with contrasting white line detailing. The original jacket has been taken apart and recut into just four headcovers. Differences in the position of the original detailing mean no two are exactly alike. Finished with a black fleece lining and our FYFE REPURPOSED woven label. Made in Scotland. Driver — 2 made Fairway — 2 made Each Second Round headcover is handmade by Fyfe Golf from a genuine pre-owned golf jacket. Any third-party brand names or logos appear only because they were on the original garment. Fyfe Golf is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by those brands, and this is not an official collaboration.

prods.title: Fulmar Herringbone Summer Tweed Headcover | Limited Edition
prods.body: Woven by an independent weaver on the Isle of Lewis, the Fulmar is a Herringbone Tweed drawing inspiration from the seabirds that drift effortlessly above Scotland's Atlantic coastline. Subtle grey tones are lifted with a refined herringbone weave, creating a cloth that feels both timeless and quietly distinctive. Each headcover is handcrafted in our Scottish workshop and finished with a rich purple fleece lining. Produced in strictly limited numbers, Fulmar Herringbone forms part of our Summer Limited Edition collection. Once this cloth has been woven and crafted, it will not return.

prods.title: Marksman Range Finder Case – Burnt Orange
prods.body: Built for precision and purpose, the Marksmen Rangefinder Case combines technical performance with refined Scottish design. Crafted from P270 waxed canvas — a durable, water-resistant fabric with a soft hand — it’s designed to withstand the demands of links golf while keeping your rangefinder protected and within reach. Inside, a space mesh lining offers added cushioning and breathability. The case features a Two-Way Waterproof YKK™ Zipper with 275 paracord pulls, a matte black brass swivel hook for secure attachment, and ¾” nylon utility webbing. Made in Scotland. Woven to the Game.

prods.body: Our Course Cases are handmade with rescued high-quality wool fabrics woven at factories in the mountain region of Serra da Estrela. prods.body: Loomed Rounds extends Mogshade’s and Soft Hands Club’s language of material, texture, and place into the spaces where golf culture is lived—homes, clubhouses, studios, and pro shops. These 100% wool posters are handmade-to-order.

prods.title: Waikahalulu FRIDAYS ONLY POLO
prods.body: Quiet from afar. Loud in meaning. This performance polo is part of the Waikahalulu Capsule with Sig On Smith, featuring a tonal jacquard map print of Honolulu’s Chinatown - the home base of Sig On Smith. A minimalist front gives way to a bold triangle back hit, symbolizing stability and movement. Cut from a breathable poly-blend with just the right stretch, this polo brings together performance construction and cultural roots for an elevated fit. Fridays only. Everyday ready.

prods.title: Sig on Smith Golf Bag
prods.body: The Waikahalulu Golf Bag marks the first-ever carry piece from Puttwell - created in partnership with Honolulu-based creative house Sig On Smith. Inspired by the energy of Chinatown - a gathering place for families, merchants, artists, and youth, this lightweight bag features Sig on Smith's signature map print - an abstract grid celebrating movement, memory, and creative flow. Blue pop accents echo the vibrancy of the neighborhood’s storefronts and skyline. Blending performance function with street-informed design, the Waikahalulu bag is both utility and tribute. A piece made to carry more than just your clubs.
